+def test_rst_with_header_rows():
+    """Test RST format with header_rows parameter"""
+    tbl = [
+        "===== =========",
+        "  a       b    ",
+        "===== =========",
+        "  1       2    ",
+        "  3       4    ",
+        "===== =========",
+    ]
+    header_rows = ["name", "unit"]
+    dat = ascii.read(tbl, format="rst")
+    out = StringIO()
+    ascii.write(dat, out, format="rst", header_rows=header_rows)
+    # The output should have the separator line, then the header rows, then the separator, then data, then separator
+    result = out.getvalue().splitlines()
+    # Check that we have the right structure
+    assert result[0].startswith("=")  # First separator line
+    assert "a" in result[1]  # First header row (name)
+    assert "b" in result[1]
+    assert result[2].startswith("=")  # Second separator line
+    assert "1" in result[3]  # Data row
